paragraphs: The Cooper Companies, Inc. (Cooper, we or the Company), is a leading global medical device company focused on helping people experience life's beautiful moments. Headquartered in San Ramon, California, Cooper sells products in over 130 countries and positively impacts over fifty million lives each year.

Cooper operates through two business segments, CooperVision and CooperSurgical. Our two business segments elevate standards of care with products and services in the fields of vision, fertility and women's health. For financial information relating to these business segments, refer to Note 12. Business Segment Information in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of this Annual Report.

CooperVision is a global manufacturer providing products for contact lens wearers. CooperVision develops, manufactures and markets a broad range of single-use, two-week and monthly contact lenses, featuring advanced materials and optics. CooperVision designs its products to address vision challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia and myopia with a broad collection of spherical, toric and multifocal contact lenses. CooperVision offers contact lenses in materials like silicone hydrogel Aquaform technology. CooperVision also manufactures and markets myopia management products, including the internally developed MiSight 1 day lens, as well as other specialty eyecare products such as orthokeratology (ortho-k) and scleral lenses. In November 2019, the MiSight 1 day contact lens became the first and only product approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for slowing the progression of myopia in children aged 8-12 at the initiation of treatment. CooperVision received approval for use of the MiSight 1 day lens in China from Chinese National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) in August 2021 and in Japan from the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) in August 2025. CooperVision's major manufacturing and distribution facilities are located in Belgium, Costa Rica, Hungary, Puerto Rico, the United Kingdom and the United States, with other smaller facilities in multiple locations around the world.

CooperSurgical offers a broad array of products and services focused on fertility and women's health. We categorize CooperSurgical product sales based on the point of health care delivery, which includes: products used in medical offices, ambulatory surgery centers and hospitals primarily by women's health providers including Obstetricians/Gynecologists (OB/GYN); and fertility products and services used primarily in fertility clinics. Our portfolio encompasses more than 600 products and services. Our medical devices are used in gynecology and obstetrics, including but not limited to surgical products, contraception and labor and delivery as well as cord blood and cord tissue storage services. Our fertility portfolio encompasses medical devices supporting the in vitro fertilization (IVF) process, egg and sperm donation, cryopreservation, and genomic services (including genetic testing). CooperSurgical has established its market presence and distribution system by developing products and acquiring companies, products and services that complement its business model. CooperSurgical's major manufacturing, cryostorage and distribution facilities are located in Costa Rica, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States, with other smaller facilities in multiple locations around the world.

CooperVision competes in the worldwide soft contact lens market and services three primary regions: the Americas, EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and Asia Pacific. The two major product categories of contact lenses sold by CooperVision are:

•Toric and multifocal lenses, including lenses that, in addition to correcting near- and farsightedness, address more complex visual defects such as astigmatism, myopia and presbyopia by adding optical properties of cylinder and axis, which correct for irregularities in the shape of the cornea; and

•Spherical lenses, including lenses that correct near- and farsightedness uncomplicated by more complex visual defects, myopia management lenses, which slow the progression of and correct myopia in age-appropriate children, and other specialty lenses.

In order to achieve a comfortable and healthier lens wearing experience, CooperVision products are sold with recommended wearing and replacement schedules, often referred to as modalities, with the primary modalities being single-use lenses designed for one-day use and frequent replacement (FRP) lenses designed for two-week and monthly replacement. CooperVision offers spherical, toric, multifocal and toric multifocal lens products in most modalities and in a wide range of lens parameters.
THE COOPER COMPANIES, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES

Under the Biofinity brand, CooperVision markets monthly silicone hydrogel spherical (including Biofinity Energys), toric, multifocal and toric multifocal (made-to-order) lens products. Our Biofinity brand is CooperVision's highest grossing product. CooperVision also markets two-week silicone hydrogel spherical and toric lenses under the Avaira Vitality brand.

CooperVision markets single-use silicone hydrogel lenses under our MyDay brand and our clariti 1 day brand. The MyDay brand is our premium line of 1-day silicone hydrogel lenses and offers spherical (including MyDay Energys), toric, and multifocal lenses. The clariti 1-day brand is our most affordable line of silicone hydrogel 1-day lenses and offers spherical, toric, and multifocal lenses. CooperVision also offers traditional single-use hydrogel lenses under our Proclear and Biomedics brands.

CooperVision focuses on supporting the growth of all customers including key accounts (which include optical chains, global retailers, certain buying groups and mass merchandisers) by investing in selling, promotional and advertising activities. Further, we are increasing investment in our distribution and packaging capabilities to support the growth of our business and to continue providing quality service with our industry leading stock keeping unit range and customized offerings.

The market for spherical lenses is growing with the addition of new value-added products, such as spherical lenses that may provide improved comfort for contact lens related dryness during lens wear and that add aspherical optical properties, more higher oxygen permeable lenses such as silicone hydrogels, and myopia management contact lenses for children aged 8 to 12 years old. CooperVision believes that there are opportunities for contact lenses to gain market share, particularly in markets where the penetration of contact lenses in the vision correction market is low.

We believe that myopia management opens up an attractive new market for contact lenses. With MiSight, we offer the only contact lens approved by the FDA1, Chinese NMPA, Japanese MHLW to slow the progression of, and correct, myopia in age-appropriate children. This is a critical differentiator as the proactive management of myopia becomes standard-of-care within the eye care community to help reduce the progression of myopia in children, along with reducing the risks of long-term eye health problems associated with myopia such as cataracts, retinal detachment, and macular degeneration. We are investing to develop this new market by educating eye care practitioners, patients and their families, which increases awareness.

paragraphs: Our business faces significant risks. These risks include those described below and may include additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial. Our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially adversely affected by any of these risks, and the trading prices of our common stock could decline by virtue of these risks. These risks should be read in conjunction with the other information in this report.

Over the last few years in the United States and globally, market and economic conditions have been challenging. The United States and foreign countries have experienced recessionary pressures and face continued concerns about the systemic impacts of adverse economic conditions and geopolitical issues. Any negative impact on economic conditions and international markets, continued volatility or deterioration in the debt and equity capital markets, inflation, deflation or other adverse economic conditions may adversely affect our liquidity and financial condition. It may limit our ability to replace maturing liabilities and to access the capital markets to meet liquidity needs, which could have a material adverse effect on our business.

Ongoing uncertain economic and financial market conditions may also adversely affect the financial condition of our customers, suppliers and other business partners. When our customers' financial conditions are adversely affected, customers may reduce their purchases of our products or we may not be able to collect accounts receivable, each of which could have a material adverse impact on our business. Our global business has been negatively affected by local economic conditions, including inflation, increasing labor costs, recession, and currency exchange rate fluctuations, which has adversely affected our cost to manufacture and provide our products and services and revenues generated through sales of such products and services. We cannot guarantee that we will be able to fully absorb any such additional costs or revenue declines in the prices for our products and services.

CooperVision and CooperSurgical are encountering consolidation in their customer bases and emergence of more centralized large customer groups and retail chains. Due to this trend, global and regional key account customers now represent a larger proportion or concentration of our business and any disruption to these relationships may have a material adverse impact on our business.

Our operating results could be materially impacted by changes in the overall macroeconomic environment and other economic factors that impact our cost structure and revenue. Changes in economic conditions, supply chain constraints, logistics challenges, labor shortages, international conflicts, and steps taken by governments and central banks, as well as other stimulus and spending programs, have led to higher inflation, which is likely to lead to an increase in costs and may cause changes in fiscal and monetary policy, including increased interest rates. In a higher inflationary environment, we may be unable to raise the prices of our products and services sufficiently to keep up with the rate of inflation.

A significant portion of our current operations are conducted and located outside the United States, and our growth strategy involves expanding our existing foreign operations and entering into new foreign jurisdictions. We have significant manufacturing and distribution sites in North America, Latin America and Europe. Approximately half of our net sales for the fiscal years ended October 31, 2025, and 2024, were derived from the sale of products outside the United States. We believe that sales outside the United States will continue to account for a material portion of our total net sales for the foreseeable future. We are optimistic about the long-term prospects for the worldwide contact lens and general health care markets, and the resilience of and growth prospects for our businesses and products. However, we face significant risks and uncertainties in our global operating environment as further described in the "Risk Factors" section in Part I, Item 1A of this filing. These risks include uncertain global and regional business, political and economic conditions, including but not limited to those associated with man-made or natural disasters, pandemic conditions, inflation, foreign exchange rate fluctuations, regulatory developments, supply chain disruptions, and escalating global trade barriers and disruptions, such as the impact of tariffs. These risks and uncertainties have adversely affected our sales, cash flow and performance in the past and could further adversely affect our future sales, cash flow and performance.

CooperVision - We compete in the worldwide contact lens market with our spherical, toric, multifocal and toric multifocal contact lenses offered in materials like silicone hydrogel Aquaform technology. We believe that there will be lower contact lens wearer dropout rates as technology improves and enhances the wearing experience through a combination of improved designs and materials and the growth of preferred modalities such as single-use and monthly wearing options. CooperVision also competes in the myopia management and specialty eye care contact lens markets with myopia management contact lenses using its ActivControl technology and with products such as orthokeratology (ortho-k) and scleral lenses. CooperVision has FDA approval for its MiSight 1 day lens, which is the first and only FDA-approved product indicated to slow the progression of myopia in children with treatment initiated between the ages of 8-12. Further, CooperVision received Chinese NMPA approval for use of the MiSight 1 day lens in China and received MHLW approval for use of the MiSight 1 day lens in Japan. CooperVision is focused on greater worldwide market penetration using recently introduced products, and we continue to expand our presence in existing and emerging markets, including through acquisitions.

Our ability to compete successfully with a full range of silicone hydrogel products is an important factor to achieving our desired future levels of sales growth and profitability. CooperVision manufactures and markets a wide variety of silicone hydrogel contact lenses. Our single-use silicone hydrogel product franchises, clariti, MyDay and MyDay Energys remain a focus as we expect increasing demand for these products, as well as future single-use products, as the global contact lens market continues to shift to this modality. Outside of single-use, the Biofinity and Avaira Vitality product families comprise our focus in the FRP, or frequent replacement product, market which encompasses the monthly and two-week modalities. Included in this segment are unique products such as Biofinity Energys, which helps individuals with digital eye fatigue.

CooperSurgical - Our CooperSurgical business competes in the fertility and women's health care market through its diversified portfolio of products and services, including fertility products and services, medical devices, cryostorage (such as cord blood and cord tissue storage) and contraception. CooperSurgical has established its market presence and distribution system by developing products and acquiring companies, products and services that complement its business model.

Competitive factors in the segments in which CooperSurgical competes include technological and scientific advances, product quality and availability, price and customer service (including response time and effective communication of product information to physicians, consumers, fertility clinics and hospitals).

paragraphs: The Cooper Companies, Inc. (Cooper, we or the Company), 是一家全球領先的醫療器材公司，專注於協助人們體驗生活中美好的時刻。總部設於美國加州聖拉蒙，Cooper 在超過 130 個國家銷售產品，每年正面影響超過五千萬人的生活。
Cooper 透過兩個業務分部運作，分別為 CooperVision 和 CooperSurgical。我們的兩個業務分部以視力、生育及婦女健康領域的產品與服務，提升照護標準。有關這些業務分部的財務資訊，請參閱本年度報告第 8 項財務資料及補充資料中第 12 註：業務分部資訊。

CooperVision 是一家全球製造商，提供接觸鏡佩戴者相關產品。CooperVision 開發、製造與行銷廣泛的單用、兩週及月用接觸鏡，採用先進的材料與光學技術。CooperVision 設計其產品以解決視力問題，例如散光、老花及近視，並提供廣泛的球面、散光及多焦接觸鏡系列。CooperVision 提供以矽水膠 Aquaform 技術為材料的接觸鏡。CooperVision 還製造與行銷近視管理產品，包括自行研發的 MiSight 1 day 接觸鏡，以及其他專門眼保健產品，如角膜塑形（ortho-k）及 scleral 接觸鏡。2019 年 11 月，MiSight 1 day 接觸鏡成為美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准的第一且唯一用於減緩 8 至 12 歲兒童近視進展的產品。CooperVision 於 2021 年 8 月獲得中國國家藥品監督管理局（NMPA）批准使用 MiSight 1 day 接觸鏡，並於 2025 年 8 月獲得日本厚生勞動省（MHLW）批准。CooperVision 的主要製造與配送設施位於比利時、哥斯達黎加、匈牙利、波多黎各、英國及美國，其他較小的設施則分佈在世界各地多個地點。

CooperSurgical 提供廣泛的產品與服務，專注於生育及婦女健康領域。我們根據醫療照護提供點，將 CooperSurgical 產品銷售分為：用於醫療診所、門診手術中心及醫院，主要由婦女健康醫療人員（包括婦產科醫生（OB/GYN））使用的產品；以及主要用於生育中心的生育產品與服務。我們的產品組合涵蓋超過 600 種產品與服務。我們的醫療器材用於婦科及產科，包括但不限於手術產品、避孕及分娩與生產，以及胎盤血與胎盤組織儲存服務。我們的生育產品組合涵蓋支持體外受精（IVF）程序的醫療器材、卵子與精子捐贈、冷凍保存及基因組服務（包括遺傳檢測）。CooperSurgical 透過開發產品與收購補充其業務模式的公司、產品與服務，建立其市場地位與配送系統。CooperSurgical 的主要製造、冷凍儲存與配送設施位於哥斯達黎加、荷蘭、英國及美國，其他較小的設施則分佈在世界各地多個地點。
CooperVision 在全球軟性接觸鏡市場競爭，並服務三個主要地區：美洲、EMEA（歐洲、中東及非洲）及亞太地區。CooperVision 銷售的接觸鏡產品主要分為兩大類：
•散光及多焦接觸鏡，包括在修正近視及遠視之外，還能處理更複雜的視覺缺陷，如散光、近視及老花的接觸鏡，透過加入柱面與軸度的光學特性，修正角膜形狀的不規則性；以及
•球面接觸鏡，包括用於修正無複雜視覺缺陷的近視及遠視的接觸鏡，近視管理接觸鏡，用於減緩並修正適齡兒童的近視進展，以及其他專門接觸鏡。
為達到舒適且健康的接觸鏡佩戴體驗，CooperVision 產品搭配建議的佩戴與更換週期，通常稱為模式（modalities），主要模式為單用接觸鏡，設計為一天使用一次，以及頻繁更換（FRP）接觸鏡，設計為兩週及月度更換。CooperVision 在大多數模式中提供球面、散光、多焦及散光多焦接觸鏡產品，並涵蓋廣泛的鏡片參數。
THE COOPER COMPANIES, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES
在 Biofinity 品牌下，CooperVision 推廣每月更換的矽水凝膠球面（包括 Biofinity Energys）、散光、多焦與散光多焦（客製）鏡片產品。我們的 Biofinity 品牌為 CooperVision 最高毛利率的產品。CooperVision 同時也在 Avaira Vitality 品牌下推廣兩週更換的矽水凝膠球面與散光鏡片。

CooperVision 在 MyDay 品牌與 clariti 1 day 品牌下推廣單次使用矽水凝膠鏡片。MyDay 品牌為我們高階的單次使用矽水凝膠鏡片系列，提供球面（包括 MyDay Energys）、散光與多焦鏡片。clariti 1-day 品牌為我們最具價格競爭力的單次使用矽水凝膠鏡片系列，提供球面、散光與多焦鏡片。CooperVision 同時也在 Proclear 與 Biomedics 品牌下提供傳統的單次使用水凝膠鏡片。
CooperVision 聚焦於支持所有客戶的成長，包括重點客戶（包括光學連鎖、全球零售通路、特定採購集團與大規模零售通路）透過投資銷售、促銷與廣告活動。此外，我們正在增加對配送與包裝能力的投資，以支持業務成長，並持續提供優質服務，搭配業界領先的庫存單位範圍與客製化產品。
球面鏡片市場因新價值增加產品的加入而持續成長，例如提供更佳舒適度的球面鏡片，以改善配戴隱形眼鏡時的乾澀感，並增加非球面光學特性，更多高氧透氣性鏡片如矽水凝膠，以及用於 8 至 12 歲兒童的近視管理隱形眼鏡。CooperVision 相信隱形眼鏡有機會增加市場佔有率，特別是在隱形眼鏡在視力矯正市場滲透率較低的地區。

我們認為近視管理為隱形眼鏡開拓了一個有吸引力的新市場。透過 MiSight，我們提供唯一獲得美國 FDA1、中國 NMPA、日本 MHLW 認可的隱形眼鏡，用以減緩並矯正適齡兒童的近視。這為主動管理近視成為眼科界標準照護程序，以幫助減少兒童近視的進展，以及降低與近視相關的長期眼健康問題風險（如白內障、視網膜剝離與黃斑變性）提供了關鍵差異點。我們正在投資開發這個新市場，透過教育眼科專業人員、患者及其家屬，提高認知度。

我們對全球隱形眼鏡及一般醫療保健市場的長期前景持樂觀態度，並對本公司業務與產品的韌性及成長潛力有信心。然而，我們在全球營運環境中面臨重大風險與不確定性，如第 I 項第 1A 項「風險因素」中進一步說明。這些風險包括不確定的全球與區域商業、政治與經濟條件，包括但不限於與人為或自然災難、疫情條件、通貨膨脹、外匯匯率波動、規範發展、供應鏈中斷，以及升級的全球貿易壁壘與中斷，例如關稅的影響。這些風險與不確定性已對我們過往的銷售、現金流與表現造成負面影響，並可能進一步對我們未來的銷售、現金流與表現造成負面影響。

CooperVision - 我們在全世界隱形眼鏡市場與本公司提供的球面、散光、多焦與散光多焦隱形眼鏡競爭，這些產品使用矽水凝膠 Aquaform 技術製成。我們認為，隨著技術進步並透過改進設計與材料，以及單次使用與每月使用選項的成長，隱形眼鏡佩戴者的流失率將降低。CooperVision 也在近視管理與專門眼保健隱形眼鏡市場與使用其 ActivControl 技術的近視管理隱形眼鏡競爭，並與如角膜塑形（ortho-k）與 scleral 鏡片等產品競爭。CooperVision 已獲得 FDA 對 MiSight 1 day 鏡片的批准，該產品為首款且唯一經 FDA 批准的產品，用於減緩 8 至 12 歲兒童近視的進展。此外，CooperVision 已獲得中國 NMPA 對 MiSight 1 day 鏡片在中國使用的批准，並獲得日本 MHLW 對 MiSight 1 day 鏡片在日本使用的批准。CooperVision 透過近期推出的產品，致力於在全球市場的更大滲透，我們持續擴展在現有與新興市場的據點，包括透過收購。

我們能成功與全系列矽水凝膠產品競爭的能力，是實現我們未來銷售成長與獲利目標的重要因素。CooperVision 生產與行銷多種矽水凝膠隱形眼鏡。我們的單次使用矽水凝膠產品品牌 clariti、MyDay 與 MyDay Energys 為我們的重點，我們預期這些產品以及未來的單次使用產品需求將增加，因為全球隱形眼鏡市場持續轉向此種模式。除了單次使用外，Biofinity 與 Avaira Vitality 產品系列為我們在 FRP（頻繁更換）市場的重點，該市場涵蓋每月與兩週使用模式。此段包括如 Biofinity Energys 等獨特產品，可幫助有數位眼疲勞的個體。
CooperSurgical - 我們的 CooperSurgical 事業透過其多樣化產品與服務組合，在生育與女性健康照護市場競爭，包括生育產品與服務、醫療器材、冷凍儲存（如臍帶血與臍帶組織儲存）與避孕產品。CooperSurgical 透過開發產品與收購補充其業務模式的公司、產品與服務，已建立其市場地位與分銷系統。
CooperSurgical 在其競爭領域中，競爭因素包括科技與科學進步、產品品質與可得性、價格與客戶服務（包括回應時間與向醫師、消費者、生育中心與醫院有效傳達產品資訊）
THE COOPER COMPANIES, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析
本公司透過專利及商標註冊保護其產品，於美國及國際市場皆有申請。本公司監測全球競爭產品之商標使用情形，並在認為適當之際，已執行並計畫持續執行及維護本公司之專利及商標權利。本公司亦依賴商業機密、授權、技術知識及持續之科技創新，以發展及維持本公司之競爭地位。
CooperVision、CooperSurgical及其他本公司及其子公司於本報告中出現之商標、商名或服務標誌，為本公司及其子公司所有。本報告中出現之其他公司之商標、商名或服務標誌，為其各自所有者所有。
接觸鏡市場有兩大產品類別：
•具有柱面與軸位光學特性之散光與多焦點鏡片，除可矯正近視與遠視外，亦可針對較複雜之視覺缺陷，如散光與老花眼進行矯正；
•球面鏡片，包括用以矯正無複雜視覺缺陷之近視與遠視鏡片、用以緩解及矯正適齡兒童近視進展之近視管理鏡片，以及其他專門用途鏡片。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
目前市場狀況及一或多個我們所處市場的衰退壓力可能影響我們擴張業務的能力。
通貨膨脹可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
我們規模龐大且持續擴張的國際業務面臨不確定性，這些不確定性可能影響我們的業務。
我們過去所進行及未來可能進行的併購及其他戰略交易涉及許多風險。
我們的競爭對手、客戶所施加的價格壓力，以及第三方覆蓋範圍與補償的變動，可能不利於我們產品的需求，並對我們的營運成果造成負面影響。
若我們未能充分保護我們的智慧財產權，我們的業務可能受到影響。
我們的產品或製程可能面臨被聲稱侵權他人智慧財產權的主張。
我們可能因產品責任聲請或與我們服務方案相關的法律聲請，遭遇損失，包括這些聲請及其他因銷售仿冒及其他侵權產品所導致的損失。
若我們的產品或服務未能被市場接受，我們將無法維持或擴展業務。
我們經營於高度競爭的醫療產業，我們無法確保我們能成功競爭。
新的醫療與科技發展可能降低對我們產品的需求。
我們面臨與環境、社會及治理相關的風險。
環境、社會及企業治理議題，包括與氣候變遷及永續相關的議題，可能對我們的業務產生不利影響，並損害我們的聲譽。
若我們無法留住關鍵人才並吸引及留住其他高素質員工，我們的業務可能會受影響。
我們章程的規定與特拉華州法律可能產生反 takeover 的效果。
與政府對我們產品及服務製造與銷售之規範相關之風險。
我們之產品即使在取得監管核准、批准或認證後，仍可能因需符合報告要求或召回而影響我們之聲譽與業務。
paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨重大風險。這些風險包括下列所述，也可能包括目前尚未知悉或本公司認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性。本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能因任何這些風險而受到重大不利影響，並可能因這些風險導致本公司普通股交易價格下跌。這些風險應與本報告中其他資訊一併閱讀。
近幾年美國與全球市場與經濟條件皆面臨挑戰。美國與外國皆經歷衰退壓力，並持續面臨對不利經濟條件與地緣政治問題之系統性影響之擔憂。任何對經濟條件與國際市場之負面影響、持續波動或惡化、通貨膨脹、通貨緊縮或其他不利經濟條件，都可能對本公司流動性與財務狀況造成不利影響。這可能會限制本公司更換到期負債與進入資本市場以滿足流動性需求之能力，這可能會對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。

持續不確定的經濟與財務市場條件也可能對本公司客戶、供應商及其他商業夥伴之財務狀況造成不利影響。當客戶財務狀況受到不利影響時，客戶可能會減少購買本公司產品，或本公司可能無法回收應收帳款，這都會對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。本公司全球業務已因當地經濟條件，包括通貨膨脹、勞動成本增加、經濟衰退與貨幣兌換率波動而受到負面影響，這已對本公司製造與提供產品與服務的成本，以及透過銷售這些產品與服務所產生之收入造成不利影響。本公司無法保證能完全吸收任何額外成本或收入減少之影響。
CooperVision 和 CooperSurgical 面臨客戶羣體的整併，以及更集中化的大型客戶羣與零售連鎖店的出現。由於此趨勢，全球與區域性的關鍵客戶現在佔本公司業務較大比例或集中度，任何對這些關係的中斷都可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司營運成果可能因總體經濟環境之變化及其他影響本公司成本結構與收入之經濟因素而受到重大影響。經濟條件之變化、供應鏈限制、物流挑戰、勞動力短缺、國際衝突，以及政府與中央銀行所採取之措施，以及其它刺激與支出計畫，已導致通貨膨脹升高，這可能會導致成本增加，並可能引發財政與貨幣政策之變化，包括利率提高。在較高通貨膨脹環境下，本公司可能無法提高產品與服務之價格以跟上通貨膨脹率。
本公司目前業務之大部分係於美國境外進行與設立，且本公司成長策略包括擴大現有海外業務與進入新海外司法管轄區域。本公司在北美、拉丁美洲與歐洲擁有重要的製造與配送據點。截至2025年10月31日及2024年財務年度，約有半數之淨銷售額來自美國境外產品之銷售。本公司認為，未來可預見之期間，美國境外銷售將持續佔本公司總淨銷售額之重要比例。國際業務與擴張計畫面臨許多額外風險，包括以下內容：
